svg.title: Sport My Fitness - Official Brand Mark
svg.desc: Tagline removed at PJ McVey's instruction on October 22, 2026 using an image-assisted cleanup of the prior approved JPEG. The overlapping leg portions were restored. SVG is a contour-derived approximation of that cleaned image with layered glow; transparent PNG is rendered from the SVG. These are derived assets, not the lost original editable design source. The previous kit remains in version history.

rdf:Alt.rdf:li: Sport My Fitness - Official Brand Mark
Sport My Fitness brand graphic with a glowing turquoise athletic symbol, SPORT MY FITNESS wordmark and luminous divider with a transparent background.
